Samir (Partnerships): Quick sync — cloud partners are pressing for a clear announce cadence for H100/H200, MI300, and Gaudi. They want a deterministic fallthrough routing plan + regional stagger. Can we lock fallback model mapping + a tentative press timeline by EOD Friday?

Jia (Eng Runtime): Yep. Draft plan: prefer vendor-native model -> vendor-quantized variant -> Redwood-hosted quantized -> hosted CPU fallback. Latency SLOs change per region though. Pasting a minimal routing draft: 

```yaml
routing_policy:
  primary: model:h100-vendor/1
  fallbacks:
    - model:h200-quantized/ff32
    - model:mi300-8bit/compat
    - model:redwood-cpu/low-latency
  regions:
    us:* -> prefer primary
    eu:* -> prefer primary, allow first fallback after 150ms
    apac:* -> cascade to quantized faster (120ms)
```

Marco (Eng Platform): That YAML looks good as a starting point. Two asks: (1) we need exact model artifact IDs (not descriptors) to wire into smart routing, (2) autoscaling signals for the first 72h of launch (canary -> ramp). Also confirm whether canary will be in us-west-2 only or multi-region.

Priya (Vendor Liaison): From the vendors I've talked to: H200 shipments look like early May for NA, EU slips to late June, APAC depends on local distribution (likely July). Gaudi partner said a 1-week micro-delay vs initial forecast. SI partners are pushing for a single global announce but are okay with staggered availability notes.

Elena (Marketing): Marketing preference is a two-phase public cadence: (A) joint partner announce with NA + global blog + embargoed press kits, (B) staggered availability notes for EU/APAC. We need firm dates by next Tue to lock press buys. Also need a gapless fallback statement approved (i.e., if H200 not available, we say "available on compatible variants" — legal will need wording).

PlatformBot: capacity-check OK: fallback pools present: us-west-2(3), eu-west-1(2). no capacity alerts.

Samir (Partnerships): Proposal / decision checklist:
- Announce strategy: staged rollout (NA -> EU -> APAC) with single joint announcement day but region-specific GA notes.
- Routing: implement Jia's fallback chain; enforcement via variant IDs (Marco).
- Canary: us-west-2 + eu-west-1 for 48h, then global ramp.
- Comms: Elena drafts joint announcement + fallback legal copy.
Action owners: Jia (routing YAML final + PR), Marco (variant ID mapping + autoscale knobs), Elena (draft comms + embargo language), Priya (vendor ETAs confirmation). Deliverables due EOD Fri for ETAs, Tue for comms deadlines.

Priya (Vendor Liaison): I'll consolidate vendor ETAs and get signed shipping windows by EOD Fri. Will call Nvidia contact tomorrow and relay.

Jia (Eng Runtime): I'll open PR with the routing policy and a small test harness. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/482 (draft). Key fallback snippet below: 

```yaml
- step: check_model
  if: available(h100-vendor/1)
  else: use(h200-quantized/ff32)
  else: use(mi300-8bit/compat)
  else: use(redwood-cpu/low-latency)
```

Marco (Eng Platform): I'll export the variant IDs by EOD and add autoscale thresholds (cpu/gpu utilization, token backlog) to the canary playbook. Will also add telemetry tags for press-time dashboards.

Elena (Marketing): Noted. I'll prod Legal for fallback copy and share a draft comms calendar in #marketing-docs by Tue. Short ask: can we agree on a 48hr buffer between announce and GA in NA so we can stage partner press?

Samir (Partnerships): 48h buffer sounds fine. Final decision: staged rollout with single announce + region GA notes, Jia/Marco/Elena/Priya own the items. We'll re-check on Monday standup. Thanks all :raised_hands: 

Priya (Vendor Liaison): Thanks — pinging partners now. Will update this thread with any redlines. :iphone: 

PlatformBot: reminder: create incident-channel for launch monitoring after PR merges.

Jia (Eng Runtime): ack, will add runbook link to PR.

Marco (Eng Platform): ack.

Elena (Marketing): ack.

Samir (Partnerships): Closing loop — leaving a short follow-up checklist in the partnerships board.
